quest.title: The Woven and the Cut
quest.description: What should one forsake, and where should one persist? The answer that the designer gives amidst cutting and knitting is...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x675, Primogem x60, Mora x44000, Guide to Light x5, Unknown Item #363364 x1, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chiori! How are the new outfits coming along? Uh, you look kinda tired.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Just a few steps left, now. I've handed the rest over to Eloffe. We should be able to make tonight's show.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's cutting it real close... Are you sure she'll be okay without you?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I have no intention of giving ground on either front. With the fashion show scheduled for tonight, Uther has closed his factory — this is our only chance to secure any incriminating evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, Paimon totally gets that this is all his fault and he totally deserves it, but wouldn't we technically be trespassing on his property if we just barge in like this?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: His factory is usually open to the public. It may not be open for business right now, but that doesn't mean visitors can't stop by for a tour.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: We're just curious customers after all, aren't we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, when you put it that way...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Anyway, Uther's factory is right over there. Let's hurry up and get moving.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Why would he open a factory over... there?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: We have different marketing strategies. While I specialize in high-end, custom garments, he prefers low prices and large sales volumes. I dunno... Maybe the rent here is cheap.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright... Ugh, it's really creepy. Paimon would never choose to buy anything from a place like that.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: You make a good point. Let's all be on our guard.

dialogues.speaker: Notebook Memorandum
dialogues.text: (Marketing expenses: 100,000 Mora. Employment expenses: 200,000 Mora. Material expenses...)

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: Letter to Chevreuse—

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: Maison Gardiennage... employee... speaking in the store of a deal between their superior and... tone was conclusive...

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: Someone... witnessed a wanted criminal... coming and going. I fear that is just a rumor...

dialogues.speaker: Paper on the Bookshelf
dialogues.text: (Some examples of Uther's old designs. There's nothing strange about them.)

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: (The courier... shall arrive at the city... in the morning, via...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place seems like some kind of warehouse. Blech... And it stinks, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? What's going on? Our way in's been blocked!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He wants to trap us in the factory...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Seems like he knew we'd be coming.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You did say he knew you really well, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Yes. And that's because... we used to be partners.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: B—But you're practically at each other's throats! Now you're telling us you used to work together!?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: When I first came to Fontaine, we were both fledging designers who longed to gain a foothold in the world of fashion. We shared the same goal, so we decided to work together.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: In the beginning, we both wanted to make clothes that would stand out from the crowd and shatter tradition — the kind of clothes that would turn heads and leave people in awe.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: But with every criticism we received, and every sponsor that rejected us... Uther's confidence disappeared little by little.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Finally, right before Fashion Week, he came to the conclusion that we wouldn't be able to make the designs we always dreamed of, and we parted ways.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: For my part, I gambled it all and devoted everything I had to that one week... I came out the other side with something that really made me proud. I was nervous to present it, of course, but I knew it was my chance to show the industry what I was made of. In the end, well...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You received the acclaim of all Fontaine, while Uther gave up on his dream and turned to making this sketchy stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I don't know the exact details of what happened after that. All I know is, after I opened Chioriya Boutique, he's harassed me every year since.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! He's just jealous of what you've accomplished. A guy like that doesn't deserve your sympathy.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Well, let's focus on getting out of here first.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Missing the show is as good as letting him win.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, there are some control panels over there! Let's see if any of those buttons do anything!

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: Letter From Emilie—

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: ...Thank you, Ms. Chiori, for your feedback on the fragrances. I've placed a sample of my newest product in this letter. It's a recent experiment with a Romaritime fragrance...

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: Also, about the schedule for the next test...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is filthy... Are the clothes from Uther's shop seriously made here?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: ...Look over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... That water looks super nasty. Paimon can smell the stench from all the way over here...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Hmph... And I was the one using unsafe materials, Uther?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So he was actually the one who opened an underground factory...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: No wonder his clothes always felt weird to the touch...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: He's been using all manner of tricks here in a bid to cut costs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Should... Should the clothes made here even be worn?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Never mind issues with shrinking and fading... These materials can give you skin problems if you wear them too often.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's terrifying... Let's take some photos right away as evidence!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This way, he won't be able to try and deny anything in court! Alright, let's keep going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally! The entrance... at last...

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: ...Oh? Those chambers couldn't hold you, I see. What a surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've collected a bunch of evidence on all the nasty stuff happening at your factory! You're not getting away this time, Uther!

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: The evidence on your person, you mean? Hah, what makes you think I have any intention of letting it get past these walls?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: ...More mechanical guards? Really? Ever thought about using these funds for a legitimate purpose?

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: Oh, but this is a legitimate purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: What? Destroying Chioriya Boutique? Or continuing to make your rotten rags?

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: —Proving that "fashion" is merely a laughable farce, a carnival of ignorance!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: ...You know what your problem is, Uther? You've become so obsessed with the concept of "fashion" itself, that you let it paralyze you. Stop trying to cater to it. Focus on your own work, and you get to decide what "fashion" means!

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: Spare me the lecture, why don't you. Sooner or later, you'll cater to all the voices too, you know. After all, what is "fashion" but another form of public opinion?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Fashion is about aspiring towards a certain ideal, but it's up to you to decide what it is. My brand caters to no one but myself and my vision — that's my ideal, and it's not going to change.

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: Hmph. Well, once the people witness their former darling's spectacular fall, they'll understand how laughable that ideal truly is.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: That's what you've been trying to prove all this time? Your jaded understanding of the industry is the reason you've had it out for my brand for so long?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: ...You weren't like this before, Uther. What happened to the man who wanted to make something that would bring the entire world to its knees?

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: He realized long ago how utterly naive and ridiculous that dream was!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: ...You gave up on your dream, but that wasn't enough, was it? You had to find a way to prove to yourself that it could never have been possible at all.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: You think you understand... but you're just a bitter man who let his regrets dictate his choices. You regret giving up on your dream, so you stopped at nothing to prove to yourself that it wasn't the wrong choice.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: This whole thing, Uther — It's pathetic.

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: Pathetic? Why don't you take a look in the mirror? You're a fool daydreaming about "taking all of Teyvat by storm." Well, good luck doing that when even Fontaine doesn't have a place for you anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: ...You're right. Maybe all those who pursue their dreams are fools.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: But more pitiful still are cowards who are too afraid to even attempt what the fool is brave enough to try.

dialogues.speaker: Uther
dialogues.text: You...!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, just leave this guy to us!

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: No, you go instead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... He has a gun...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: It'll be fine. Just go to the venue and tell everyone to proceed with the plan.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: I'll deal with him. Some lessons... are best delivered in person.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Catch up with us soon!

response.speaker: Uther
response.text: Trying to leave, are we?

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: I've held back all this time because of our past partnership, Uther...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: But all that changed after our "tour" of your factory.

response.speaker: Uther
response.text: Hmph... Still trying to talk tough, I see.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: No matter what you've been through, no matter why you've become like this...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: If I may borrow the words of a friend — a guy like you doesn't deserve my sympathy.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Allow me to show you... the true meaning of the Chioriya brand.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: ...How about this?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: A little more to the left.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: ...Like this?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Phew!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Ooh! That looks great! Miss Chiori, can I take a picture?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I didn't know you'd made a brand-new signboard!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I made it before Fashion Week. I figured it'd be best to put it up after the success of the show.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, how can you become renowned through all of Teyvat without a fancy signboard of your own? The Spina's way ahead of you in that regard!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, perhaps our magic troupe could use one of those.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Our signatures are the Grin-Malkin Cat and the Bogglecat Box. Oh, and we'd need to add Pers as well.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Pers would need an alias, of course. Hmm, how about... the "Hangry Bird"?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Pfft... Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: So does that mean your signboard is going to be... two cats and a penguin stuffed into a single hat?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Ooh, that sounds super snuggly and warm!

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: And a bit cramped...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: #Miss Chiori! I'm done taking pictures. You can expect the article in tomorrow's Steambird, along with the evidence {NICKNAME} gathered!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Thank you, Charlotte.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: It's my pleasure! Bringing the truth to light is a journalist's duty.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Going forward, feel free to custom-order any accessories you need for Monsieur Verite. It's on the house.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Huh!? Y—You really mean it?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Of course. The same goes for you too, Lyney, Lynette. If you have need of any costumes in future, just drop me a note.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: What about something other than a costume?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Thank you, Chiori. It's much appreciated.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, I don't really need anything! Just don't be a stranger, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I don't need anything, either! So long as you continue to request my international courier services from Komaniya Express, we're golden!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Actually, that reminds me... When will you be leaving, Kirara?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Huh!? Erm... About that...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: The Spina di Rosula has prepared a special vehicle for you, so you can just get in, and we'll push it all the way out of Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: What, no, that's so embarrassing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, do we get something nice too, Chiori?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Of course. Just hold on a second...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Disrupting public order at the show, appropriating venue lighting equipment without authorization, using weaponry in public, hosting a dangerous performance without notifying the authorities...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, Chevreuse, we can explain...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: ...If you come across anyone who matches those descriptions, please report them to the Special Patrol at your earliest convenience.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Enjoyed that, didn't you? You nearly scared me half to death!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Says the one who pulled that stunt earlier. How about you do me a favor and tell me in advance next time you're planning something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: And if I had, would you have approved?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: No, but it would've at least spared me a whole lot of anxiety.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Well, I would say I've more than made it up to you, have I not? A whole underground workshop in the Fleuve Cendre, and the man responsible all tied up and handed to you on a silver platter! Sounds pretty thoughtful, if you ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: ...Alright, I won't argue with you. You can have this one.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, friends, I would say we've earned ourselves a nice meal for our efforts! Let's go! Spina's treat!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I'll have to take a raincheck. I've still got a lot of paperwork to take care of, so you all go have fun.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: By the way, Chiori, I ran into Wenger on the way here. He had a message for you.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I don't need to hear it — I'm sure the old fool used pretty much every apology in the book. I'll just visit him some other day and give him a hard time about everything.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Hah, you know him well.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Thanks again, Chevreuse.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: My pleasure. Oh, and one last thing—

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: That was really quite an amazing show.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: You don't say?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, follow me if you want in on the celebration feast! Come on, we're leaving!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, could you go wait for me at that place with the view? I'll let Navia know that we'll be a little late. There's something I'd like to give you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A place with a view? Ooh! Paimon knows where you mean! Sure, no problem!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Perfect. I'll be right there.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We didn't wait long at all! But what did you wanna give us that you couldn't share right in front of everyone else?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: ...Here. Take this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh wow... a brooch! And in the style of Chioriya Boutique, too! Wait, Paimon gets one as well?

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I've only made two for now. After much consideration, I decided to give them to you two.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: You've been a great help. Even when things were looking bleak, you stayed by my side.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: There were even times when I felt like I had to fight back and win, even if it was just to honor the trust that you had in me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we may have helped a little, but Paimon would say you deserve most of the credit. This result... It was all you, Chiori!

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: I know for certain that was not the case.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: I've chased my dream for so long that I've come to understand something...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Apart from conviction and persistence, the thing that matters the most is having friends who believe in you even when you don't believe in yourself.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: A single person can only do so much. Without all your help, Chioriya Boutique could have easily fallen to ruin.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon doesn't think it would have ever gotten to that point... Not if you had anything to say about it. But, um, about the stuff you said at the show... You aren't worried it'll rub some people the wrong way?

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Perhaps my words were a little pretentious, but they do reflect how I truly feel. I won't bow or scrape before any force in this world, much less any individual.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: I'm confident in the quality of my work. Create something beautiful, and there will always be people who appreciate it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, guess there's nothing to worry about, then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should we go back and join them at the victory feast?

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Oh yes, of course. But before that, I'd like to admire the view for just a little while longer.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: You know? Of all the nights I've spent in Fontaine, I'd say this is the loveliest by far.

choices.text: I'll take good care of it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Chiori said that she needs all the time she can get to make the clothes for the fashion show. Best not to disturb her for now...)

dialogues.speaker: Fashion Week Promotional Poster
dialogues.text: The much-anticipated Fontaine Fashion Week has begun!

dialogues.speaker: Fashion Week Promotional Poster
dialogues.text: Many renowned designers have gathered for this event. Their meticulously crafted, brand-new works will be on display during the final show.

dialogues.speaker: Fashion Week Promotional Poster
dialogues.text: Let the light of fashion shine upon the City of the Arts!

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: Travel Plans—

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: I've heard there's a new clothing trend in Natlan. Will check it out when I have some time...

dialogues.speaker: Notes on the Table
dialogues.text: Snezhnayan designs can be used as reference for winter wear... if it's on the way...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After the fashion show, everyone returns to Chioriya Boutique...
